profile.headline: Creator of Software and Data Solutions
profile.summary: Seasoned software engineer with excellent troubleshooting and "big picture" skills in search of new opportunities and challenges.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Analyze client requirements for development of BI data warehouses and Dashboard reports with a mindful eye of the ever-changing landscape (legal and otherwise) of healthcare and documentation requirements - HIPAA, HI-TECH, etc. Extraction, processing, and presentation of data from a myriad of systems totaling petabytes of data. System application maintenance of a variety of systems and development of new applications to support the daily operations of numerous facilities and campuses in the Capital Division of HCA, one of the largest health care operations in the world.

Integral member of team that developed the HCA Innovators Award winning application, IV Guardian.
Overhauled 3 proprietary, site-specific hospitalist-patient tracking applications to a flexible single design available for use in all 17+ division campuses, and designed ready for corporate-wide uplift, if necessary.

positions.title: .NET Developer II
positions.description: Troubleshooting of any system issues on an as needed basis.  Maintenance and development of new features for their existing Bostwick Renaissance platform.  This involved development in ASP.NET using C# and javascript as well as development of numerous SQL Server tables, data types, stored procedures, and functions to support the proprietary legacy data objects layer.  Instruction in HIPAA compliance was also mandatory.

positions.title: Database Administrator / Software Developer
positions.description: Analyze legacy Progress/OpenEdge code and migrate to intranet ASP.NET (VB and C#) system.  Provide data analysis for in house clients and develop new custom coded reports and updates in a very rapid response environment.  Provide database expertise in new BI initiative and work towards the development of datamarts to provide more capable and flexible reporting for both internal and external clients.  Provide additional C# and object oriented code assistance for all parts of the system.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Six month contract to hire at RetailData. Analyze legacy Progress/OpenEdge code and migrate to intranet ASP.NET (VB and C#) system.  Provide data analysis for in house clients and develop new custom coded reports and updates in a very rapid response environment.

positions.title: Freelance/Consultant
positions.description: Designed the database and initial web interface for a pilot project for an out-of-state architecture's public building inspection inventory system for use in procurement and justification of government funding.  Installed home networks and network security, acted as software and hardware technician for local clientele on an as-needed basis.

positions.title: Software/Systems Engineer
positions.description: Analyze, develop, and implement updated desktop and PDA field applications for a configurable serialized device tracking system typically having 1-3 million devices.  Work with team to design and implement a reusable, flexible core system to improve core product, reduce custom development, and thereby improve profitability.  Act as database administrator and SQL programming technical expert for local office needs.

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst / Technical Manager
positions.description: Primary technical resource for software products, database design, and all legacy systems.  Collaberated with project manager to manage and assign development resources for projects.  Lead developer for majority of software projects.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst / Acting DBA
positions.description: Lead or work with team to design and implement n-tier service-based update of flagship client-server based product.  Provide assistance and maintenance of existing product and legacy systems.  Design or assist in design of upgrade paths for legacy based custom systems.  Work with team to interface products with client enterprise systems.  Maintain, update, and develop new interfaces to customer testing hardware.  Provide database expertise as needed.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Maintain and service existing C and C++ legacy systems.  Design and develop upgrade to PowerBuilder based applications.  Provide relational database expertise to improve performance of overall systems.  Lead or work with team to move current design paradigm to configuration based common core.  Maintain or update software interfaces to customer testing hardware.  Work with team to interface applications to client enterprise systems.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Maintain and service existing C and C++ legacy systems.  Develop PowerBuilder based system editor user application for flagship serialized device tracking system.  Maintain or update software interfaces to customer testing hardware.  Work with team to interface applications to client enterprise systems.

positions.title: Sole Proprieter
positions.description: Worked as a consultant, primarily for Automated Micro Systems, through a period of economic turmoil.  Intall and service networks and small databases for small businesses and homes.  Build and maintain PC's and networks.

positions.title: Computer Technician
positions.description: Build, test, and install PC computers for customers.  Build and install networks using various topologies, including Arcnet, Ethernet, Pro-net.  Support office computing requirements.  Install and service Sybase database servers at customer sites.
